name: Blue Insulated Medicine Case
description: A blue insulated case containing medical doses intended for delivery via clinic launch. Set on the ferry ticket office counter by Tom, who instructs that it not be left in the locker.
narrative_significance: A time-sensitive medical delivery prop that establishes Tom's responsibility for his father's healthcare and triggers Lena's decision to personally escort the case to the clinic launch, separating the siblings and setting up subsequent plot developments.
